## Security and privacy checklist

- [ ] No secrets or real user data in code, fixtures, logs, screenshots, or tests
- [ ] AI redaction boundary reviewed, if AI-affecting
- [ ] AI process remains tool-less and network-denied, if AI-affecting
- [ ] Lock state and secret exposure behavior checked, if vault-affecting

## Definition of done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria pass end to end

- [ ] CI passes
- [ ] Reviewer assigned
- [ ] No unresolved scope or dependency blocker
